def author_date(path, exclusion_flag: '[exclude]', dita: false)
logs = git.gblob(path_to_file).log
last_non_excluded_commit = logs.detect { |log| !log.message.include?(exclusion_flag) }
pdfs_by_modified_date = Dir.glob(dir_path + '**/*.pdf').sort_by{ |f| File.mtime(f) }

def modified_date(default_date: nil)

date = page_last_modified_date || parsed_default_date
"Page last updated: " if date
